snippet.description:
في هذا الفيديو، نكشف عن واحدة من أشهر وأخطر الخرافات الطبية المتوارثة في بيوتنا: "رفع الرأس لأعلى لوقف نزيف الأنف".
الشرح الطبي: إرجاع الرأس للخلف لا يوقف النزيف، بل يجعل الدم يتراجع إلى الخلف لينزل في الحلق والمعدة، مما يسبب غثياناً وقيئاً دموياً مرعباً، والأخطر أنه قد يتسرب إلى مجرى التنفس ويسبب الاختناق!
التصرف الصحيح (الإسعافات الأولية):
1. إمالة الرأس للأمام قليلاً (للسماح للدم بالخروج وعدم بلعه).
2. الضغط بقوة على الجزء الطري من الأنف (أرنبة الأنف) لمدة 10 دقائق متواصلة.
3. وضع كمادات ثلج على الأنف لتضييق الأوعية الدموية وتسريع وقف النزيف

snippet.title: Quasi un milione di euro di risarcimento alla famiglia del piccolo Domenico, il bambino del cuore…
snippet.description:
Un milione di euro comprese le spese legali. È questa la cifra liquidata dall'Azienda Ospedaliera dei Colli nell'ambito della trattativa stragiudiziale per il risarcimento nei confronti della famiglia del piccolo Domenico Caliendo, il bambino di due anni, morto il 21 febbraio per le conseguenze di un trapianto di cuore fallito il 23 dicembre scorso. La cifra, che doveva rimanere coperta da segreto, è stata menzionata in una deliberazione, la numero 785, datata 8 ottobre 2026, pubblicata sul sito web dell'azienda ospedaliera specialistica di Napoli, in un documento a firma della direttrice Anna Iervolino e da altri cinque responsabili della struttura. Alla famiglia sono andati 960mila euro, mentre all'avvocato Francesco Petruzzi, legale dei genitori del piccolo Patrizia Mercolino e Antonio Caliendo, poco più di 40mila euro.

«I 960mila pattuiti per il risarcimento stragiudiziale ottenuto al termine della trattativa per il decesso del piccolo Domenico Caliendo – fa sapere l'avvocato Petruzzi – sono al netto delle spese legali e non comprendono i danni derivanti dal reato di falso e dalle spese medico-legali sostenute in occasione dell'incidente probatorio, stimate in alcune centinaia di migliaia di euro. La scelta di non comprendere queste voci nel risarcimento stragiudiziale – spiega il legale – ci consente di poterci costituire parte civile all'eventuale processo per omicidio colposo accanto alla Procura della Repubblica di Napoli. Altrimenti, non sarebbe stato possibile. In sostanza, il resto del risarcimento lo chiederemo agli imputati, tra cui ci sarà il cardiochirurgo Guido Oppido».

snippet.title: The FIRST EVER Mercedes-AMG GT SUV! — Full First Look
snippet.description:
Welcome back to RBR! And to the all-new #MercedesAMG GT SUV is here! And I think the design is finally getting to where we need it to be. This is a much improved car in it’s look, all thanks to the new design team now heading both Mercedes Benz and AMG. Looking more like an ICE car, and less awkward than the GT 4 door sibling — I think it’s a big step in the right direction!

Today is a First Look at the new #AMGGT SUV, the second member of AMG's AMG.EA family. And with three different versions, GT 53, GT 55 and GT 63, AMG is taking the fight directly to the new Porsche Cayenne Electric. It also exists as an alternative to the pure V8 power also available as new cars at AMG, with the GLE 63S and the GLS 63.

Underneath, the flagship AMG GT 63 SUV retains the three extraordinary axial-flux motors, delivering 1,169 PS and 2,000 Nm! That's enough for 0–100 km/h in just 2.5 seconds, and 0–200 km/h in an incredible 6.8 seconds! The GT 55 offers 816 PS, while the more affordable GT 53 uses conventional electric motors with a two-speed rear gearbox, producing 544 PS.

This time, there are two battery options, 106 kWh and 128 kWh, with the larger one offering, up to 710 kW charging, and a maximum WLTP range of 700 km. Then there's the new AMG ACTIVE RIDE CONTROL+ suspension, with pitch and roll stabilisation as now AMG’s best suspension offered so far.

The biggest question is whether an electric AMG can deliver the emotion of a proper AMG engine — in my experience of driving the 4 door it can, thanks to AMGFORCE Sport+. This uses recordings of the legendary AMG GT R. It recreates V8 sounds, simulated gear changes, paddle shifting and even physical vibrations through the seats. Crucially, it makes the electric experience essentially indistinguishable from the ICE experience.

Inside, we also have a completely new AMG cockpit, MB.OS infotainment and the fascinating AMG RACE ENGINEER controls, allowing drivers to fine-tune the car's response, agility and traction. And finally, we'll explore the SUV's practicality, rear seats, and boot etc!

In this episode:
* New Mercedes-AMG GT SUV 
* Exterior design Solarbeam yellow and Magno Graphite
* GT 53, GT 55 and GT 63 specifications
* Axial-flux motors and AMG.EA platform
* New Big battery and range
* New AMG ACTIVE RIDE CONTROL Active Plus suspension
* GT 63 SUV vs GT 4-Door and Porsche Cayenne Electric Turbo
* New AMG interior and MB.OS
* AMGFORCE Sport+ V8 sound demonstration
* AMG RACE ENGINEER driving controls
* Rear seats, SKY CONTROL roof and practicality
* Pricing and final thoughts

So, could this be the electric AMG that finally wins over more traditional AMG enthusiasts? I feel the SUV is actually more appealing, but I’d love to hear what you think!
